learning_outcomes.description: Design Effective Web Interfaces for E-Commerce Platforms

performance_criteria.description: Design user-friendly navigation structures that guide customers effortlessly through the e-commerce site, using clear menus, breadcrumbs, and search functionality to enhance the user experience.

Create responsive designs that adapt seamlessly to different devices (e.g., mobile, tablet, desktop) using fluid grids, flexible images, and media queries to ensure a consistent user experience across platforms.
Implement a visually appealing layout that balances text, images, and white space, enhancing readability while emphasizing key products or calls-to-action (CTAs) to improve conversion rates.
Optimize website performance by compressing images, minifying CSS and JavaScript, and leveraging caching techniques, ensuring fast load times and a smooth user experience on e-commerce platforms.

learning_outcomes.description: Understand Relational Database Design and Structure

performance_criteria.description: Design a database schema using entity-relationship diagrams (ERD) to represent the relationships between products, customers, and transactions.
Normalize database tables to eliminate redundancy and ensure efficient storage of data.
Define primary and foreign keys to establish relationships between database tables (e.g., linking customer and order data).
Use SQL queries to retrieve, insert, update, and delete data from the database.

Implement backup and recovery plans to protect data in case of system failures or cyber-attacks

learning_outcomes.description: Ensure Database Security and Integrity

performance_criteria.description: Use database encryption techniques to protect sensitive customer data, such as personal information and payment details.
Implement user roles and permissions to restrict access to sensitive data and prevent unauthorized database modifications.
Perform regular database audits to detect and address potential security vulnerabilities.
Ensure data integrity by enforcing validation rules and constraints on database fields (e.g., ensuring product prices are positive).
